en_title: 'Crazy Secretive' — GTA 6 Voice Actor Reveals Details of Rockstar's 'Humongous' NDA
cn_title: 「保密程度疯狂」——《GTA 6》配音演员透露Rockstar「厚得惊人」的保密协议细节
opus_summary: 《GTA 6》电台主持人配音演员Issa Lopez称，参与演出前签署的保密协议文件厚得惊人，堪比买房或买车的手续。她直到录音当天才看到台词，也未被告知项目名称，后来根据邮件中的线索猜出了答案。

paragraphs.en: A voice actor who appeared in GTA 6 described the wild non-disclosure agreement she had to sign before working on the game, calling the project “crazy secretive.”
paragraphs.cn: 一名参与《GTA 6》的配音演员描述了她在参与游戏制作前必须签署的惊人保密协议，称该项目「保密程度疯狂」。

paragraphs.en: Issa Lopez is a voice actor who plays a radio host on GTA 6’s fictional Cocoteo FM radio station, a Latin channel that plays reggaeton and dembow tracks featuring Spanish-speaking artists from the Caribbean and Latin America.
paragraphs.cn: Issa Lopez是一名配音演员，在《GTA 6》的虚构电台Cocoteo FM中饰演一名电台主持人。这个拉丁频道播放来自加勒比地区和拉丁美洲的西班牙语歌手演唱的雷鬼顿和dembow歌曲。

paragraphs.en: In a November 20 interview with Page Six , Lopez revealed that she recorded her lines for the station as recently as September 2026, and said the NDA she was made to sign before officially performing the part was comparable to the process of purchasing a home or a vehicle.
paragraphs.cn: 在11月20日接受Page Six采访时，Lopez透露，她为该电台录制台词的时间近至2026年9月，并表示她在正式演绎这个角色前被要求签署保密协议，那过程堪比购买房屋或汽车。

paragraphs.en: “Have you ever signed papers to buy a house? To buy a car? You know, it’s thick! It was a pretty humongous pack of papers that came with it. But I mean, it’s worth it! And I didn’t have to wait like all these other folks. Some of these folks have been working on this for like 10–11 years, you know what I mean?” she said.
paragraphs.cn: 她说：「你签过买房的文件吗？买车的呢？你知道的，那可是厚厚一沓！随之而来的是相当厚的一大包文件。但我是说，这是值得的！而且我不用像其他所有人那样等待。有些人参与这个项目已经有10到11年了，你明白我的意思吗？」

paragraphs.en: She went on to describe the recording process for her lines, saying that she hadn’t seen anything until the day of the performance. With no time to prepare, she was essentially “put on the spot” — but she was so excited about the opportunity that she didn’t mind.
paragraphs.cn: 她接着描述了自己录制台词的过程，称直到表演当天她才看到相关内容。由于没有时间准备，她基本上是「被临时推上阵」——但她对这个机会感到非常兴奋，因此并不介意。

paragraphs.en: “In my usual voiceover gigs — let’s say you want me to do a commercial for you. I get a Zoom [link] maybe the day before, maybe the same day I get the script,” she explained. “Everything was like, popped up on the screen. It was mad cool. It was like, ‘You ready? And I’m like, ‘Uh-huh.’ You press a button and then boop, it pops on the screen, they say hello, and there’s a bunch of people in your ear. And they’re like, ‘Okay, here it is,’ and that’s when you see it. You are put on the spot. And you better bring it. And after that, I don’t know — whatever was in front of my face disappeared. “
paragraphs.cn: 她解释道：「在我平时的配音工作中——假设你想让我为你配一支广告。我可能会提前一天收到Zoom链接，也可能在当天收到剧本。」「所有东西都是那样，突然出现在屏幕上。那真是酷毙了。就像是，『你准备好了吗？』我说，『嗯哼。』按下一个按钮，然后啵的一声，内容就出现在屏幕上，他们打个招呼，你耳边就传来一群人的声音。他们说，『好了，就是这个，』然后你才看到它。你被临时推上阵。而且你最好拿出真本事。那之后，我不知道——我眼前的东西就消失了。」

paragraphs.en: Lopez revealed that she wasn’t told what the project was for, but figured it out based on context clues from an email titled “heard by millions,” saying she “read it and knew what it was for.” She also didn’t know that Bad Bunny would be co-hosting the Cocoteo station alongside her, leading to a wild realization once Rockstar released the radio stations before the game actually came out.
paragraphs.cn: Lopez透露，没有人告诉她这个项目是做什么的，但她根据一封标题为「数百万人都能听到」的邮件中的上下文线索猜了出来，称她「读完就知道这是做什么的」。她也不知道Bad Bunny会与她共同主持Cocoteo电台，直到Rockstar在游戏正式推出前公布电台信息时，她才惊讶地意识到这一点。

paragraphs.en: “We knew nothing. I saw the liners, and when I saw the liners I was like, ‘Okay, I know why I got the gig.’ ‘Cause it was like Puerto Rican dot com. It was super easy. But it was so cool, because Rockstar let me be myself. …they were like, ‘Issa, we want natural. Whatever you got, we want,'" she said.
paragraphs.cn: 她说：「我们什么都不知道。我看到了电台串场词，看到的时候我就想，『好吧，我知道为什么我能接到这份工作了。』因为那简直就像Puerto Rican dot com。那超级容易。但这太酷了，因为Rockstar让我做自己。……他们说，『Issa，我们要自然。你有什么，我们就要什么。』」

paragraphs.en: The actors in GTA 6 were extremely secretive about their involvement in the project. Most notably, actress Manni L. Perez, who plays Lucia, was under immense pressure after fans sleuthed her social media accounts and figured out it was her before she could officially reveal the information. Now, she’s up for best performance at The Game Awards, which is one of eight nominations the game has secured mere weeks before the show takes place this December.
paragraphs.cn: 《GTA 6》的演员们对自己参与该项目一事守口如瓶。最引人注目的是饰演Lucia的演员Manni L. Perez：粉丝们调查了她的社交媒体账号，在她能够正式公布这一消息之前就认出了她，这让她承受了巨大压力。如今，她获得了The Game Awards最佳表演奖提名；距离今年12月颁奖典礼举行仅有几周之际，这也是游戏获得的八项提名之一。

paragraphs.en: Other performers who have finally revealed their involvement in the game are Mandy’s actress, Lexie Shoaibi , as well as the voice and performance artist for Jason Duval, Dylan Rourke . Rockstar released the full credits for the game, too, which you can check out here — just beware of spoilers if you haven’t finished it yet.
paragraphs.cn: 其他终于公开参与这款游戏的表演者还有Mandy的扮演者Lexie Shoaibi，以及为Jason Duval提供配音和表演的Dylan Rourke。Rockstar也公布了游戏的完整制作人员名单，你可以在此查看——如果你还没有通关，请注意剧透。
